rationale_md: The United States enters this Group D clash with a commanding 280-point Elo advantage over Paraguay, reflecting the vast gulf in current form and quality between these two sides. This substantial rating gap translates to heavy favoritism for the hosts, who should control proceedings against a Paraguayan squad that has struggled to match the competitive level of top CONCACAF and South American nations. Expect the Americans to dictate tempo and create numerous scoring opportunities in what appears to be one of the more lopsided matchups in the group stage.
